learning_objective: 🎯 Let us read about a little girl named Madhu and her very special magical wish!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Madhu is a sweet little girl who loves to look up at the starry night sky and dream about wonderful things.
One beautiful night, she sees a bright shooting star and makes a very kind wish from the bottom of her heart.
When we wish for good things for others, sometimes the universe does a little magic to make our sweet dreams come true.

fun_activity.title: 🌠 Make a Wish
fun_activity.instructions: Close your eyes and make a kind wish for your best friend. Draw a beautiful picture of your wish in your notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ Madhu loves to look at the dark night sky and dream.
⭐ She makes a very kind wish upon a shooting star.
⭐ Wishing good things for other people spreads a lot of happiness.
